purpose: Production constraints for planning, preparation and evidence-bound repair. Rules constrain the process, not entities or themes.
asset_spec: Assign distinctive isolated exterior landmarks and vegetation to Tripo; assign traversable buildings, passages, roads, terrain and scalable repetitions to Blender. Generated exteriors are not certified interiors.

Reserve new generation for identity-critical missing assets. Submit independent remote assets before polling; preserve task IDs through local repair. Do not regenerate all sources after a local scene or runtime failure.
Describe complete branching anatomy or botanical structure, intentional gaps, target physical height and visible source acceptance. Do not repair melted geometry by scattering many copies.
Read installed source usage_guidance. A specimen strip or sample sheet is not a volumetric plant; choose its reviewed individual-specimen representation when scattering.

Prioritize the few missing sources that establish the requested visual identity, including near-view architecture or technology when central to the brief. Do not discover all identity-critical assets only after full scene assembly.

Fresh production has no previous case meshes or private catalogs. Choose public PBR source IDs and new distinctive generation for this brief; standard installed motion templates remain an explicit dependency.
art_plan: Select actual albedo swatches and matched PBR channels. Multiplicative tint cannot produce opaque bright paint from dark brown wood; use the supported paint parameters when appropriate.

Plan visual masses for the combat margins, every destination, connecting routes and outer background. Instance count alone does not establish coverage or composition; do not alternate global overplanting and global removal.

Give each region a functional structure, ground transition, foreground/middle/background relationship and palette role. The style may be natural, cultivated or urban; no compulsory ruins, moss, pink flowers or low saturation.
Retain accepted functional layouts while batching diagnosed local repairs. A cropped or foreshortened structure needs a matching side/elevated diagnostic before reconstruction.

Make emissive elements physically mounted and compose broad value/color masses first. Futuristic identity may require characteristic equipment or vehicle silhouettes as well as signs; parked props do not imply a driving mechanic.
Use distinct functional paving/work surfaces with bounded local wetness. Inspect the final UE coordinate basis at asymmetric locations before diagnosing a spatial material-mask mismatch.

Surface masks must reach shader consumers. Preserve local wear color, matched normal/roughness and physical scale. Overcast scattering and practical-light levels are independent decisions from exposure.

NullRHI import does not compile every runtime shader. Reject native material fallback before trusting screenshots. Color-transfer corrections are source-specific; compare native RGB before applying any transfer correction.
scene_layout: Use per-source usage_guidance, preserve_aspect, placement and physical dimensions. Asset scale is a target envelope in metres, not an arbitrary multiplier. Buildings use their base; rocks may use an appropriate footprint; keep complete objects clear of routes.

Use one supported elevation contract for detailed terrain, paving, foundations and structural whitebox. Continuous support and shallow physical seams are required; inherited floor heights can bury a new court.

Plan destination edges and connecting landscape together before increasing scatter counts. Keep intentional combat space open and compose its margins; preserve distinct destinations and at least one real route junction.

Repeated non-colliding detail uses shared source geometry automatically; collision geometry retains independent clearance checks. Default exports are bounded to 4 million source triangles per batch and UE workers to 8 million. Do not flatten thousands of repeated plants into a single huge FBX.
Resolve resource, placement, semantic and missing-generated-asset errors together before starting Blender. Actual saved-geometry, current UE camera and performance checks still decide acceptance.
Single-sided panels preserve authored winding; closed-mesh normal recalculation can reverse their visible face. Keep physical backing, clear routes and shared structural transforms.
Roof services need supported bases and dimensioned envelopes. Select transformed component groups in world coordinates; a local-coordinate selection can silently miss displaced parts.
Destination diagnostics must anchor the actual requested place and verify its projection. Default and switched camera modes apply the same projection-specific render policy.

Normalize structure ownership and reject conflicting duplicate placement before Blender. Route elevation is shape-preserving; probe real walking support with a bounded foot envelope, never teleport the probe onto a roof.

Use footprint-aware foundations. Preserve natural-court relief when requested. Apply deposits and ruts after flattening, then enforce stair/floor envelopes and excavated channels so additive detail cannot bury them.
Size the terrain apron for all requested camera footprints, not only the combat disc. Exterior silhouettes and actual route boundaries must agree.
Masonry, timber lodge, urban frontage and natural terrain are selectable construction capabilities. Do not substitute one fixed building language or material palette across every new prompt.
review_and_capture: An ambiguous shadow, cropped arch or disconnected-looking gallery requires current source-matched oblique and ground-level diagnostics before geometry reconstruction; preserve prior refusal and explain the resolved interpretation.
Run the exact full first-person combat five-channel probe before long gameplay QA. Validate real contact, early activity, capsule presence and the actual near plane.

Same-run verified export reuse requires matching source content, job, rendering, exporter and every output hash. Do not alter upstream committed exports. Final independent calibration and native/export gates still apply.
Independent camera runs can exhibit sub-centimetre bone drift despite fixed simulation steps. Claim exact modality pairing within each capture, not bit-identical cross-run trajectories.
Use diagnose and impact before repeated full rebuilds. Record repair cause, new evidence, owner, scope and result. Timings include executing-agent work; uncertain gaps are not established idle time.
convergence: Preserve the original brief in source, environmental and final reviews; use built descriptors to resolve intent without treating names as visual proof.

After three distinct environmental refusals, require a diagnosis tied to the latest refusal and current source, with complete issue coverage and hashed evidence; distinguish uncertainty from reconstruction.
Test complete requested camera/activity clips early; retain immutable per-job exports and revalidate matching files in final pairing.
Check actual exploration player masks under canopy and architecture; an open-space camera-switch test cannot prove visibility along a route.
Support dry authored interiors and glass measurement policy explicitly; keep matched structural geometry and retain authoring winding.
Measure complete user wall time; fewer duplicate captures are an implementation change, not a proven end-to-end speedup.
